methodologyNotes: Prices fetched June 2026 via WebFetch from official vendor pages and reputable review/comparison sites. Official vendor pages (rosettastone.com/buy confirmed via direct fetch — $19.99/mo, $159/yr) are treated as primary sources. Duolingo's pricing pages are JS-only; prices corroborated against multiple 2026 comparison sources (dealnews.com May 2026, duoplanet.com) — Super annual $6.99/mo, Max $29.99/mo monthly and $168/yr ($14/mo) annual. Babbel consumer per-month single-language website prices ($9.95/$8.45/$6.95) confirmed by two independent 2026 sources (fluentin3months.com and edureviewer.com). ADVERSARIAL VERIFICATION (2026-06-14): Original Busuu figures (Premium $13.95/mo, $83.40/yr; Premium Plus $139.99/yr) could NOT be confirmed against current 2026 sources — multiple 2026 reviews (testprepinsight.com, talkreal.org) indicate Busuu has consolidated Premium/Premium Plus into a single Premium plan with annual ~$62.99/yr ($5.25/mo) and monthly ~$10.50, contradicting the stale FluentU/App Store figures; per verification policy all unconfirmable Busuu paid monthlyUsd values set to null. Original Memrise figures ($22.99/mo, $71.99/yr, $100 lifetime) could NOT be confirmed — 2026 sources cite monthly $14.99–$24.99, annual $61.99 (not $71.99), and lifetime $329.99 ($100 is a promo coupon, not standing price); unconfirmable Memrise paid monthlyUsd values set to null. Pimsleur corrected: independent 2026 sources (myelearningworld.com) confirm Premium single-language = $19.95/mo (was mislabeled $20.95) and All Access = $20.95/mo (was null but is in fact confirmable). annualDiscountPct computed only where both monthly and annual prices are confirmed. All telephony fields (minutesIncluded, callsIncluded, overagePerMin, overagePerCall) are null as these are non-telephony products.

vendors.name: Duolingo
vendors.provenance: Official duolingo.com pages are JS-rendered and return empty content. Prices sourced from duoplanet.com (independent Duolingo coverage site, article dated Oct 7 2025 titled 'Duolingo Free vs Super vs Max') and corroborated against duoplanet.com/duolingo-max/ article. Super Duolingo monthly (pay-as-you-go) price was not stated in any source accessed; only the annual rate ($6.99/mo) was confirmed.

plans.name: Free
plans.notes: Permanently free with ads and limited hearts system. Covers all languages with core lessons.

plans.name: Super Duolingo (Annual)
plans.notes: Billed as $83.88/year. Removes ads, unlimited hearts, practice mistakes, mastery quizzes. Monthly pay-as-you-go rate not confirmed in any source accessed and is omitted. Annual rate 'starts at $6.99/month' per duoplanet.com article Oct 2025.

plans.name: Duolingo Max (Monthly)
plans.notes: Pay-as-you-go monthly rate. Adds AI-powered Roleplay and Video Call features on top of Super Duolingo benefits. Available in select markets/languages only.

plans.name: Duolingo Max (Annual)
plans.notes: Billed as $168/year ($14/month). Saves ~53% vs $30/month pay-as-you-go. Same AI features as Max monthly.

vendors.name: Rosetta Stone
vendors.provenance: Prices fetched directly from rosettastone.com/buy (official pricing page, accessed June 2026 via WebFetch — page returned full content with prices). Corroborated against rosettastone.com/buy/gift page. Both fetches confirmed $19.99/month and $159/year with no lifetime plan.

plans.name: Monthly
plans.notes: Month-to-month subscription. Access to all 25 languages. Includes TruAccent speech recognition, Chat Missions, 500+ flashcard sets, Sapphire Studio. 14-day money-back guarantee.

plans.name: Annual
plans.notes: Billed as $159/year ($13.25/month). Saves 33% vs monthly plan. Access to all 25 languages with same features as monthly plan. 14-day money-back guarantee.

vendors.name: Babbel
vendors.provenance: Official babbel.com/en/prices and pricing pages returned 404 or empty content. Prices sourced from fluentin3months.com Babbel review page (updated April 18 2025), which cites web subscription prices. Corroborated against Apple App Store listing (apps.apple.com, accessed June 2026). Note: App Store shows a 1-month option at $17.99 for single-language iOS in-app purchase, which differs from the website's cheapest plan of 3 months; website prices are lower than App Store due to Apple's commission. Website prices from fluentin3months.com are used as monthlyUsd (the recurring effective monthly rate).

plans.name: 3-Month Subscription
plans.notes: Billed as $29.85 every 3 months ($9.95/month). Covers all 14 Babbel languages. Website pricing; iOS in-app price is higher ($45.99/3 months per App Store). No free trial; first lesson of any course is free.

plans.name: 6-Month Subscription
plans.notes: Billed as $50.70 every 6 months ($8.45/month). Covers all 14 Babbel languages. Website pricing.

plans.name: 12-Month Subscription
plans.notes: Billed as $83.40/year ($6.95/month). Best-value plan; saves ~30% vs 3-month rate. Covers all 14 Babbel languages. Website pricing; iOS App Store shows $107.99/year for all-languages plan.

vendors.name: Busuu
vendors.provenance: ADVERSARIAL VERIFICATION (2026-06-14): Original figures (Premium $13.95/mo and $83.40/yr from FluentU; Premium Plus $139.99/yr from App Store) could NOT be confirmed against current 2026 sources. Multiple independent 2026 reviews (testprepinsight.com Busuu review, talkreal.org Busuu costs) indicate Busuu has consolidated the former Premium/Premium Plus split into a single Premium plan, with annual at ~$62.99/yr (~$5.25/mo) and monthly at ~$10.50 — materially different from and contradicting the stale FluentU/App Store numbers originally recorded. Because no credible source confirms the original figures and the live structure appears to have changed, all paid Busuu monthlyUsd values are set to null per verification policy rather than asserting an unverifiable price. Free tier (0) retained.

plans.name: Free
plans.notes: Free tier with limited lessons across 14 languages. Community access included. No offline mode or certificates.

plans.name: Premium (Monthly)
plans.notes: Month-to-month Premium plan. Original $13.95/mo figure (FluentU) could NOT be confirmed; 2026 sources indicate monthly is closer to ~$10.50 but no single credible source agrees precisely, so monthlyUsd set to null per verification policy. Includes no ads, offline mode, vocabulary/grammar reviews, streak repair, certificates, complete courses across 14 languages.

plans.name: Premium (Annual)
plans.notes: Annual Premium plan. Original $83.40/year ($6.95/month effective) figure (FluentU) could NOT be confirmed; 2026 sources (talkreal.org) cite annual at ~$62.99/year (~$5.25/mo), materially lower. Because credible sources disagree with the recorded figure and cannot confirm it, monthlyUsd set to null per verification policy. Same feature set as Premium monthly.

plans.name: Premium Plus (Annual)
plans.notes: Former Premium Plus tier. Original $139.99/year ($11.67/month effective) figure from an App Store listing could NOT be confirmed and appears stale: multiple 2026 reviews report Busuu has merged Premium Plus into a single Premium plan, so a standing separate Premium Plus annual price is no longer verifiable. monthlyUsd set to null per verification policy. Historically added AI Conversations, pronunciation coaching, grammar Mistake Repair, and specialty topic courses on top of Premium.

vendors.name: Pimsleur
vendors.provenance: ADVERSARIAL VERIFICATION (2026-06-14): Original entry had the two Pimsleur tiers crossed. Independent 2026 source (myelearningworld.com Pimsleur pricing) confirms Premium (single-language) = $19.95/month (the original $20.95 figure was actually the All Access rate) and All Access (all 51 languages) = $20.95/month (originally recorded as null, but it IS confirmable). Both corrected. All Access annual also published at $164.95/year (~$13.75/mo) but the plan is recorded here on a monthly basis. The 'Starting at $150' marketing line on the homepage refers to a one-time single-level audio purchase, not a subscription.

plans.name: Premium (Single Language, Monthly)
plans.notes: Single-language subscription at $19.95/month (corrected from $20.95, which was the All Access rate). Includes audio lessons, flashcards, and supplementary materials. Price confirmed by myelearningworld.com 2026 pricing breakdown. 30-day money-back guarantee offered.

plans.name: All Access (Monthly)
plans.notes: Access to all 51 Pimsleur language courses at $20.95/month (corrected from null — the figure is confirmable). An annual All Access plan is also published at $164.95/year (~$13.75/mo effective). Price confirmed by myelearningworld.com 2026 pricing breakdown. 30-day money-back guarantee offered.

vendors.name: Memrise
vendors.provenance: ADVERSARIAL VERIFICATION (2026-06-14): Original FluentU-sourced figures (monthly $22.99, annual $71.99 / $5.99 effective, lifetime $100) could NOT be confirmed against current 2026 sources and are internally inconsistent across the web. 2026 reviews report monthly at $14.99 (fahimai.com / edureviewer earlier table) up to $24.99 (App Store), annual at $61.99/year (recurring across talkreal/App Store, NOT $71.99), and lifetime at $329.99 ($100 is a one-off promo-coupon figure, not the standing price). No single credible source confirms the originally recorded $22.99/$71.99/$100 set, so all paid Memrise monthlyUsd values are set to null per verification policy rather than asserting unverifiable prices. Free tier (0) retained.

plans.name: Free
plans.notes: Free tier with limited daily video access (3 videos/day), limited review and listening features. MemBot AI conversation limited.

plans.name: Pro (Monthly)
plans.notes: Month-to-month Pro. Original $22.99/month figure (FluentU) could NOT be confirmed; 2026 sources cite anywhere from $14.99 to $24.99/month with no agreement, so monthlyUsd set to null per verification policy. Unlocks all lessons, unlimited native-speaker videos, unlimited speaking practice, difficult-words feature, ad-free.

plans.name: Pro (Annual)
plans.notes: Annual Pro. Original $71.99/year ($5.99/month effective) figure (FluentU) could NOT be confirmed; the recurring credible 2026 figure is $61.99/year (~$5.17/mo), not $71.99. Because the recorded figure cannot be verified, monthlyUsd set to null per verification policy. Same feature set as Pro monthly.

plans.name: Pro (Lifetime)
plans.notes: One-time lifetime purchase; monthlyUsd null as it is non-recurring. The originally cited $100 figure is a promo-coupon price, not the standing rate — the consistent 2026 standing lifetime price is $329.99. Either way no recurring monthly value applies.

plans.name: Babbel for Business
plans.notes: B2B team language learning. Starting at $8.99/user/month. Custom pricing for larger teams. Includes team analytics, manager dashboard, and enterprise features. Price from GetApp listing; official business page requires contact-sales for full pricing.
